scripts.text: SELECT AGP.CIRS_STATUS_LOG_SEQ_ID.NEXTVAL AS RUNID FROM DUAL

INSERT INTO AGP.CIRS_STATUS_LOG (RUNID, INBOUNDFILENAME, FILETYPE, FILELOADDTM)
    VALUES (@RUNID,@AuthFileName,'AUTH',SYSDATE)

INSERT INTO AGP.CIRS_STATUS_LOG (RUNID, INBOUNDFILENAME, FILETYPE, FILELOADDTM)
    VALUES (@RUNID,@AuthTermFileName,'AUTH_TERM',SYSDATE)

UPDATE AGP.CIRS_STATUS_LOG Log
        SET TOTALRECORDS = (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AGP.CIRS_AUTHORIZATION_DATA WHERE RUNID = LOG.RUNID)
        WHERE INBOUNDFILENAME = @AuthFileName AND FILETYPE = 'AUTH' AND RUNID = @RUNID

UPDATE AGP.CIRS_STATUS_LOG SET TOTALRECORDS = @AuthTermRecCount
        WHERE INBOUNDFILENAME = @AuthTermFileName AND FILETYPE = 'AUTH_TERM' AND RUNID = @RUNID

INSERT INTO AGP.CIRS_STATUS_LOG (RUNID, INBOUNDFILENAME, FILETYPE, FILELOADDTM)
    VALUES (@RUNID,@ConfFileName,'CONF',SYSDATE)

INSERT INTO AGP.CIRS_STATUS_LOG (RUNID, INBOUNDFILENAME, FILETYPE, FILELOADDTM)
    VALUES (@RUNID,@ConfTermFileName,'CONF_TERM',SYSDATE)

UPDATE AGP.CIRS_STATUS_LOG LOG SET TOTALRECORDS = (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AGP.CIRS_CONFIDENTIAL_COMM_DATA WHERE RUNID = LOG.RUNID)
        WHERE INBOUNDFILENAME = @ConfFileName AND FILETYPE = 'CONF' AND RUNID = @RUNID

UPDATE AGP.CIRS_STATUS_LOG SET TOTALRECORDS = @ConfTermRecCount
        WHERE INBOUNDFILENAME = @ConfTermFileName AND FILETYPE = 'CONF_TERM' AND RUNID = @RUNID

INSERT INTO AGP.CIRS_STATUS_LOG (RUNID, INBOUNDFILENAME, FILETYPE, FILELOADDTM)
    VALUES (@RUNID,@RestFileName,'REST',SYSDATE)

INSERT INTO AGP.CIRS_STATUS_LOG (RUNID, INBOUNDFILENAME, FILETYPE, FILELOADDTM)
    VALUES (@RUNID,@RestTermFileName,'REST_TERM',SYSDATE)

UPDATE AGP.CIRS_STATUS_LOG LOG SET TOTALRECORDS = (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AGP.CIRS_RESTRICT_DATA WHERE RUNID = LOG.RUNID)
        WHERE INBOUNDFILENAME = @RestFileName AND FILETYPE = 'REST' AND RUNID = @RUNID

UPDATE AGP.CIRS_STATUS_LOG SET TOTALRECORDS = @ResTermRecCount
        WHERE INBOUNDFILENAME = @RestTermFileName AND FILETYPE = 'REST_TERM' AND RUNID = @RUNID

UPDATE AGP.CIRS_STATUS_LOG LOG 
    SET OutboundFileName = @AuthOBFileName,
             TotalSubsetRecs = (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AGP.CIRS_AUTHORIZATION_DATA WHERE RUNID = LOG.RUNID AND TRIM(ERROR_CODE) IS NULL),
             TotalErrorRecs = (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AGP.CIRS_AUTHORIZATION_DATA WHERE RUNID = LOG.RUNID AND TRIM(ERROR_CODE) IS NOT NULL),
             Status = 'COMPLETED'
        WHERE  RUNID = @RUNID AND FileType = 'AUTH'

UPDATE AGP.CIRS_STATUS_LOG LOG 
    SET OutboundFileName = @ConfOBFileName,
             TotalSubsetRecs = (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AGP.CIRS_CONFIDENTIAL_COMM_DATA WHERE RUNID = LOG.RUNID AND TRIM(ERROR_CODE) IS NULL),
             TotalErrorRecs = (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AGP.CIRS_CONFIDENTIAL_COMM_DATA WHERE RUNID = LOG.RUNID AND TRIM(ERROR_CODE) IS NOT NULL),
             Status = 'COMPLETED'
        WHERE  RUNID = @RUNID AND FileType = 'CONF'

UPDATE AGP.CIRS_STATUS_LOG LOG 
    SET OutboundFileName = @RestOBFileName,
             TotalSubsetRecs = (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AGP.CIRS_RESTRICT_DATA WHERE RUNID = LOG.RUNID AND TRIM(ERROR_CODE) IS NULL),
             TotalErrorRecs = (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AGP.CIRS_RESTRICT_DATA WHERE RUNID = LOG.RUNID AND TRIM(ERROR_CODE) IS NOT NULL),
             Status = 'COMPLETED'
        WHERE  RUNID = @RUNID AND FileType = 'REST'

RestOBQuery.defaultValue: 'select * from AGP.CIRS_RESTRICT_DATA WHERE RUNID = 1 AND TRIM(ERROR_CODE) IS NULL AND FileType IN ('REST', 'REST_TERM')'

ConfOBQuery.defaultValue: 'select * from AGP.CIRS_CONFIDENTIAL_COMM_DATA WHERE RUNID = 1 AND TRIM(ERROR_CODE) IS NULL AND FileType IN ('CONF', 'CONF_TERM')'
